Contract Generator.contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::makeReservation(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		requestedUser: User = User.allInstance()->any(u|u.UserID = uid),
		requestedCopy: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(c|c.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		requestedUser.oclIsTypeOf(User) and
		requestedCopy.oclIsTypeOf(BookCopy) and
		User.allInstance()->includes(requestedUser) and
		BookCopy.allInstance()->includes(requestedCopy)
	postcondition:
		result = Reserve.allInstance()->exists(r|r.ReservedUser = requestedUser and
		r.ReservedCopy = requestedCopy)
}
